The crew pulls jade boulders off the J lens but a big snag with the road threatens everything.
Gary and son rescue an old army truck but driving it up to the mine is brutal.
Claudia, Robin and the crew scramble to get their heavy equipment up a mountain before rising rivers make it impossible to get to the mining claim.
Tensions flare as the crew struggles to get heavy equipment up a muddy, boulder-strewn 120km trail to set up a new jade mine on a mountaintop.
The crew tries to get their machinery across surging rivers to set up their new mountaintop jade mine.
Alan is convinced there's jade under a pit full of water on their Dynasty claim. Josh's mechanical skills are tested while trying to get a giant boulder to a new buyer.
Springtime begins as Laramy honors the history of the mountain men by trapping for beaver and other critters.
Deep in the Alaskan territory, Laramy hunts forcCaribou until a severe accident with the Hawken throws the whole hunt into question.
Laramy can't let his injry slow him down. He recaps the incident before rolling up his sleeves to carry on hunting the mountain man way.
Forging one's own tools was a valuable skill for the mountain men. Laramy takes hammer to steel as he shows us how he crafts his own gear.
With a tag in pocket, Laramy takes to the mountains of Idaho on the hunt for the elusive elk.
Winter trapping requires different skills than trapping in the spring. Laramy pulls out all the tricks to trap for critters.
Laramy hunts the steep climbs of Idaho for mountain whitetail. Hunting these mountains in the old way makes for a tremendous challenge.

The remaining participants struggle to adapt to life in Patagonia. One survivor comes face to face with a stealth cat, and another takes on a major build project.

Dangerous challenges wreak havoc on the participants and force most to consider going home. While one is plagued by a potentially life-threatening infection, another battle against serious hypothermia.

As winter draws nearer, and fish stop biting, the participants turn to the land game to survive the season. But their intended prey turns out to be more clever--and more deadly--than they could imagine.

Winter arrives in full force, and the remaining survivors must deal with rapidly deteriorating conditions. The lack of protein pushes some to new levels of depletion, and the pull to see family is more than some can bear.
The boys head to Iceland in search of the Atlantic Wolfish. These terrifying-looking, deep-sea monsters are the ultimate anti-heroes, keeping the entire marine ecosystem from collapsing.
